resolution.reason: Normalized malformed and unusable repository-owned schema failures to MUTATION_MANIFEST_READ_FAILED while preserving ContractValidationError; added regressions for malformed JSON and an unresolvable schema reference, independently re-reviewed with focused suites passing.

findings.title: Malformed mutation schema JSON bypasses the manifest reason-code contract

summary: Security re-review confirms the four REV-0003 findings are closed but blocks final approval because malformed repository-owned mutation schema JSON escapes as a raw JSONDecodeError instead of the frozen MUTATION_MANIFEST_READ_FAILED reason code.
